lessons.name: Aches and Pains
lessons.description: Say what hurt and how you got better, in the past tense.

multiple_choice.name: Match the aches
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My head hurt
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера ме болеше главата цял ден." means "Yesterday my head hurt all day."

true_false.name: True or false: Kolene
true_false.sentence: The plural of "коляно" (knee) is "колене".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Like other body parts, it has an irregular plural.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My leg hurts
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Боли __ кракът и не мога да ходя.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Боли ме кракът и не мога да ходя." means "My leg hurts and I cannot walk."

fill_in_the_blank.name: My sister was ill
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сестра ми беше болна цяла седмица." means "My sister was ill all week."

true_false.name: True or false: Ramo
true_false.sentence: "Рамо" means "knee".
true_false.explanation: "Рамо" means "shoulder". A knee is "коляно".

multiple_choice.name: Match the illness verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I cough all night
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Настинах и сега кашлям цяла нощ." means "I caught a cold and now I cough all night."

true_false.name: True or false: Sneezing
true_false.sentence: When someone sneezes, Bulgarians say "Наздраве!"
true_false.explanation: Correct. The same word is used for a toast.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The children recovered
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Децата __ бързо и вече са на училище.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата оздравяха бързо и вече са на училище." means "The children got better quickly and are back at school."

lessons.name: At the Pharmacy
lessons.description: Ask for medicine and understand how to take it.

multiple_choice.name: Match the pharmacy words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Something for a sore throat
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имате ли нещо __ болки в гърлото?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имате ли нещо против болки в гърлото?" means "Have you got anything for a sore throat?"

true_false.name: True or false: Prescription only
true_false.sentence: Some medicines in Bulgaria are sold only with a doctor's prescription.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Others are sold "без рецепта", without one.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two tablets a day
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Взимайте по две таблетки на ден." means "Take two tablets a day."

fill_in_the_blank.name: After meals
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сиропът се пие след хранене." means "The syrup is taken after meals."

true_false.name: True or false: Lepenka
true_false.sentence: "Лепенка" is a cough syrup.
true_false.explanation: A лепенка is a sticking plaster.

multiple_choice.name: Match the instructions
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Only with a prescription
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Това лекарство се продава само __ рецепта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Това лекарство се продава само с рецепта." means "This medicine is sold only with a prescription."

true_false.name: True or false: Vitamini
true_false.sentence: In Bulgarian, "витамини" are vitamins.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The singular is витамин.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The pharmacist recommended
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вчера фармацевтът ми __ сироп за кашлица.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера фармацевтът ми препоръча сироп за кашлица." means "Yesterday the pharmacist recommended a cough syrup to me."

lessons.name: At the Doctor's
lessons.description: Make an appointment, answer the doctor and get a sick note.

multiple_choice.name: Match the doctor's words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: An appointment with my GP
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Записах си час при личния лекар." means "I made an appointment with my GP." "Час" here means an appointment.

true_false.name: True or false: Lichen lekar
true_false.sentence: In Bulgaria your GP is called your "личен лекар".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "personal doctor".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The doctor examined me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Лекарят ме __ и ми даде рецепта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Лекарят ме прегледа и ми даде рецепта." means "The doctor examined me and gave me a prescription."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Open your mouth
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Отворете устата и кажете „а“." means "Open your mouth and say 'ah'."

true_false.name: True or false: Bolnichen
true_false.sentence: "Болничен" is a hospital building.
true_false.explanation: A болничен is a sick note for work. A hospital is a "болница".

multiple_choice.name: Match the doctor's questions
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English sentence to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: How long has it hurt
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "От колко време ви боли гърлото?" means "How long has your throat been hurting?" The present with "от" covers something still going on.

true_false.name: True or false: Kakvo vi ima
true_false.sentence: "Какво ви има?" is how a doctor asks "What's wrong with you?"
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "What do you have?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two weeks off
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Лекарят ми даде болничен за две __ и ми каза да почивам.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Лекарят ми даде болничен за две седмици..." means "The doctor gave me two weeks' sick leave and told me to rest."

lessons.name: Keeping Fit
lessons.description: Training, gyms and staying in shape.

multiple_choice.name: Match the fitness words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The workout lasts an hour
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тренировката трае един час." means "The workout lasts an hour."

true_false.name: True or false: Trenyor
true_false.sentence: A "треньор" is a sports coach.
true_false.explanation: Correct. A female coach is a "треньорка".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Five kilos lighter
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Отслабнах пет килограма за два месеца." means "I lost five kilos in two months."

fill_in_the_blank.name: I ran a marathon
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналата година пробягах маратон." means "Last year I ran a marathon." A finished achievement takes the perfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Otslabvam
true_false.sentence: "Отслабвам" means "to put on weight".
true_false.explanation: "Отслабвам" means "to lose weight". Putting it on is "напълнявам".

multiple_choice.name: Match the fitness verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: He lifts weights
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той вдига тежести във фитнеса." means "He lifts weights at the gym."

true_false.name: True or false: Fitnes
true_false.sentence: In Bulgarian, "фитнес" usually means a gym.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Ходя на фитнес" means "I go to the gym".

fill_in_the_blank.name: You will be healthier
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще бъдеш по-здрав, ако спортуваш." means "You will be healthier if you do sport."

multiple_choice.name: Match the match words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two all
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Двата отбора завършиха два на два." means "The two teams drew two all."

true_false.name: True or false: Ravenstvo
true_false.sentence: A match that ends 1:1 is a "равенство" (draw).
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Мачът завърши наравно" also means "The match ended in a draw".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Who scored first
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кой вкара първия гол?" means "Who scored the first goal?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: Our team won
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Отборът ни __ с три на нула!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Отборът ни спечели с три на нула!" means "Our team won three nil!" Отборът is singular.

true_false.name: True or false: Sadiya
true_false.sentence: In football, the "съдия" is the goalkeeper.
true_false.explanation: The съдия is the referee. The goalkeeper is the "вратар".

multiple_choice.name: Match the positions
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The keeper saved the penalty
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вратарят спаси дузпата." means "The goalkeeper saved the penalty."

true_false.name: True or false: Duzpa
true_false.sentence: "Дузпа" is a penalty kick.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The word comes from the Turkish for "straight".

fill_in_the_blank.name: We will watch the match
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре ще гледаме мача по телевизията." means "Tomorrow we will watch the match on TV."

multiple_choice.name: Match the party words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I turn thirty
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре навършвам тридесет години." means "Tomorrow I turn thirty."

true_false.name: True or false: Treating on birthdays
true_false.sentence: In Bulgaria, the person celebrating a birthday usually treats friends and colleagues.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bring sweets to the office, or pay for the drinks.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Mum made a cake
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Миналата година за рождения ми ден мама __ торта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналата година за рождения ми ден мама направи торта." means "Last year Mum made a cake for my birthday."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Happy birthday
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Честит рожден ден и много щастие!" means "Happy birthday and lots of happiness!"

true_false.name: True or false: Navarshvam
true_false.sentence: "Навършвам" means "to forget".
true_false.explanation: "Навършвам" means "to reach" an age: "навършвам 18 години".

multiple_choice.name: Match the birthday wishes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The children blew out the candles
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата духнаха свещите на тортата." means "The children blew out the candles on the cake."

true_false.name: True or false: Za mnogo godini
true_false.sentence: "За много години" wishes someone many more years.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is said on birthdays and name days.

fill_in_the_blank.name: What shall I give you
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Какво да ти __ за рождения ден?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Какво да ти подаря за рождения ден?" means "What shall I give you for your birthday?"

lessons.name: Name Days
lessons.description: Saints' days, the names that go with them and how to congratulate people.

multiple_choice.name: Match names and name days
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each name to the day its bearers celebrate.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Nikolay celebrates today
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Днес е Никулден и __ има имен ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Днес е Никулден и Николай има имен ден." means "Today is St Nicholas' Day, and Nikolay celebrates his name day."

true_false.name: True or false: Nikulden fish
true_false.sentence: On Nikulden (6 December) it is traditional to eat fish.
true_false.explanation: Correct. St Nicholas is the patron of fishermen, so carp is the classic dish.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Happy name day
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Честит имен ден на всички Ивановци!" means "Happy name day to all the Ivans!"

fill_in_the_blank.name: He treated his colleagues
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На имения си ден той __ всички колеги.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На имения си ден той почерпи всички колеги." means "On his name day he treated all his colleagues."

true_false.name: True or false: Only children
true_false.sentence: Only children celebrate name days in Bulgaria.
true_false.explanation: Everyone celebrates them, and for many people a name day matters as much as a birthday.

multiple_choice.name: Match the name day words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the sixth of May
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гергьовден се празнува на шести май." means "St George's Day is celebrated on 6 May." An exact date takes на.

true_false.name: True or false: Imennik
true_false.sentence: A person celebrating a name day is called an "именник".
true_false.explanation: Correct. A woman celebrating is an "именничка".

fill_in_the_blank.name: To congratulate him
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ще се обадя на Иван, за да го __ за имения ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще се обадя на Иван, за да го поздравя за имения ден." means "I will call Ivan to congratulate him on his name day."

lessons.name: A Jubilee
lessons.description: Round-number birthdays and anniversaries, speeches and toasts.

multiple_choice.name: Match the jubilee words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A big jubilee
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Дядо направи голям __ за осемдесетия си рожден ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дядо направи голям юбилей за осемдесетия си рожден ден." means "Grandpa threw a big party for his eightieth birthday."

true_false.name: True or false: Yubiley
true_false.sentence: A "юбилей" is a round-number anniversary, such as 50 or 60 years.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarians celebrate round birthdays in style.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Thirty years married
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Родителите ми празнуваха тридесет __ от сватбата си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Родителите ми празнуваха тридесет години от сватбата си." means "My parents celebrated thirty years since their wedding."

fill_in_the_blank.name: His son gave a speech
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Синът му държа реч на празника." means "His son gave a speech at the party." Държа is also the past form of the verb.

true_false.name: True or false: Godishnina
true_false.sentence: "Годишнина" means "a birthday cake".
true_false.explanation: A годишнина is an anniversary.

multiple_choice.name: Match the jubilee phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English sentence to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The guests danced
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гостите танцуваха до късно през нощта." means "The guests danced until late at night."

true_false.name: True or false: Gordeem se
true_false.sentence: "Гордеем се с теб" means "We are proud of you".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Гордея се" is "I am proud".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Relatives and friends
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Поканихме всички роднини и приятели." means "We invited all our relatives and friends."

lessons.name: A Bulgarian Wedding
lessons.description: The couple, the witnesses and the customs of a Bulgarian wedding.

multiple_choice.name: Match the wedding words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A white dress
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Булката беше в бяла __ с дълго було.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Булката беше в бяла рокля с дълго було." means "The bride wore a white dress with a long veil."

true_false.name: True or false: Kum and kuma
true_false.sentence: At a Bulgarian wedding the "кум" and "кума" are the official witnesses.
true_false.explanation: Correct. They are often also godparents to the couple's first child.

fill_in_the_blank.name: They exchanged rings
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Младоженците си размениха халки." means "The newlyweds exchanged rings."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Dancing the horo
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гостите играха хоро цяла нощ." means "The guests danced the horo all night."

true_false.name: True or false: Halka
true_false.sentence: "Халка" is a wedding cake.
true_false.explanation: A халка is a wedding ring.

multiple_choice.name: Match the wedding verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: He proposed to her
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той ѝ предложи брак на Коледа." means "He proposed to her at Christmas." Ѝ means "to her".

true_false.name: True or false: Breaking bread
true_false.sentence: At Bulgarian weddings the newlyweds often pull a round loaf apart to see who gets the bigger piece.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Tradition says whoever gets the bigger piece will lead the family.

fill_in_the_blank.name: They invited us to their wedding
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Поканиха ни на __ си през юни.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Поканиха ни на сватбата си през юни." means "They invited us to their wedding in June."

lessons.name: National Holidays
lessons.description: The flag, the anthem and the days Bulgaria remembers.

multiple_choice.name: Match the national words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Liberation Day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На Трети март празнуваме __ на България.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На Трети март празнуваме Освобождението на България." means "On 3 March we celebrate the Liberation of Bulgaria."

true_false.name: True or false: The flag
true_false.sentence: The Bulgarian flag is white, green and red.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The three stripes run from top to bottom in that order.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Education and culture
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На 24 май празнуваме българската __ и култура.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На 24 май празнуваме българската просвета и култура." means "On 24 May we celebrate Bulgarian education and culture."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A day off
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Шести септември е почивен ден." means "6 September is a public holiday." Ден is masculine.

true_false.name: True or false: 3 March
true_false.sentence: Bulgaria's national day, 3 March, marks the Unification of 1885.
true_false.explanation: 3 March marks the Liberation of 1878. The Unification is celebrated on 6 September.

multiple_choice.name: Match the ceremony words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Laying wreaths
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хората поднасят венци пред паметника." means "People lay wreaths at the monument."

true_false.name: True or false: Buditeli
true_false.sentence: On 1 November Bulgaria honours the "народни будители", who awakened the national spirit.
true_false.explanation: Correct. They were teachers, writers and clergy of the National Revival.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We were at the parade
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Миналата година __ на парада в София.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналата година бяхме на парада в София." means "Last year we were at the parade in Sofia."
